name: branch8-jira-check
description: At every Claude Code session start: shows which Claude account the session uses and warns when a non-organisation account works on a company project; checks the Jira connection and Jira account; asks once per project which Jira board it uses and records it locally; asks for a Jira ticket on each new task and creates one if there is none. Settings in config.env. Adds /jira-check and /jira-board.
